live_unit_evidence.name: Heffing doorberekenen in prijs
live_unit_evidence.current_scope: Calculate consumer pass-through percentage of a per-unit tax using P0, Pc, and tax amount.
live_unit_evidence.observed_risk: The procedure also mentions producer remainder and elasticity explanation, so D07 may be too broad for one exact operation.

live_unit_evidence.name: Evenwicht bij accijns
live_unit_evidence.current_scope: Calculate new tax equilibrium and tax revenue after a heffing.

live_unit_evidence.name: Evenwicht met heffing
live_unit_evidence.current_scope: Calculate new equilibrium after a tax and analyze consumer/producer distribution.
live_unit_evidence.observed_risk: A23 already includes distribution language and A15, creating possible overlap with D07 and possible elasticity over-trigger.

live_unit_evidence.name: Na-belasting of na-subsidie aanbodfunctie afleiden
live_unit_evidence.current_scope: Derive after-tax or after-subsidy supply function and determine Pc/Pp.

live_unit_evidence.name: Procentuele prijsverandering na kostenverandering
live_unit_evidence.current_scope: Calculate percentage price change after a cost change.
live_unit_evidence.boundary: A93 explicitly warns that price change is not incidence or pass-through share.

live_unit_evidence.name: Subsidie en Pareto-efficientie
live_unit_evidence.current_scope: Explain whether a subsidy equilibrium is Pareto efficient.

live_unit_evidence.name: Welvaartsverlies bij subsidie
live_unit_evidence.current_scope: Determine and shade deadweight loss from subsidies.

target_exercise_evidence.title: Belastingen: wig en nieuw evenwicht
target_exercise_evidence.finding: D07 appears over-triggered for 3.1.1 because the target asks equilibrium, Pc/Pp, and tax wedge drawing, not pass-through percentage.

target_exercise_evidence.title: Belastingdruk en welvaartsverlies
target_exercise_evidence.finding: A D07-style tax incidence lane is appropriate here, but the human review should decide whether D07 should split amount, percentage, and elasticity explanation.

target_exercise_evidence.title: Subsidies
target_exercise_evidence.finding: Subsidy incidence or subsidy benefit-sharing is not represented by a dedicated MTU.

target_exercise_evidence.title: Overheidsingrijpen bij marktfalen
target_exercise_evidence.finding: Pigouvian tax calculation currently uses A23, not D07. This remains context evidence only for MTU-H3.

planning_only_candidate_lanes.proposed_scope_for_review: Tax afwentelingspercentage calculation from P0, Pc, and tax amount.
planning_only_candidate_lanes.review_issue: Should D07 be narrowed to percentage pass-through only, and should elasticity explanation move elsewhere?

planning_only_candidate_lanes.proposed_scope_for_review: Tax wedge and Pc/Pp graphical labeling without requiring afwentelingspercentage.
Tax burden amounts in euros split between consumer and producer before percentage conversion.
Subsidy equilibrium and effective consumer/producer price split.
Subsidy benefit-sharing between consumer and producer.
Explain incidence using relative demand and supply elasticities.
Cost-shock pass-through share, kept distinct from A93 percentage price change.

recommended_review_groups: 3.1.2 tax burden amount and percentage split
